newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -7 Oct 27 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -7 Oct 27 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index dropped two points to -7 in the week ended October 27.

The survey, this time with 1,029 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy fell two points to -16, down from -14 the prior week.
Confidence in personal finances slipped to 18 from 20, and Americans' rating of buying climate fell two points to -24.
Regionally, confidence increased in the West, but it declined in the Northeast, Midwest and South.
